children.zh-CN: 被包裹的内容；有内容时 Spin 作为包裹元素，加载期间带 `aria-busy`，且内容不可聚焦、不可操作（inert）。
children.en-US: Wrapped content. With content, Spin acts as a wrapper and carries `aria-busy` while loading, and the content cannot be focused or operated (inert).

delay.zh-CN: 延迟显示加载效果的时间，单位毫秒。
delay.en-US: Delay in milliseconds before the loading effect is shown.

minDuration.zh-CN: 加载效果显示后至少保持的时间，单位毫秒，避免加载刚显示就结束时闪烁。
minDuration.en-US: Minimum time in milliseconds the loading effect stays once shown, so a load that ends right after it appears does not flash.

indicator.zh-CN: 自定义加载指示符的 snippet。
indicator.en-US: Snippet for a custom loading indicator.

spinning.zh-CN: 是否处于加载中的状态。

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 child（包裹内容的元素）、indicator（加载指示器，传入 indicator 时为其外层包裹元素）、tip（提示文字），追加在自带类名之后。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by child (the element wrapping the content), indicator (the loading indicator, or the element wrapping a given indicator) and tip (the tip text), appended after the built-in class names.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的样式字符串，键同 classNames。
styles.en-US: Style strings of the inner parts, keyed like classNames.

tip.zh-CN: 当 Spin 作为包裹元素时，描述文字的 snippet。
tip.en-US: Snippet for the description text, used when Spin acts as a wrapper.
